title: Financial Literacy
description: For school leavers earning or about to earn their first money. Learn to budget, save, use mobile money safely, borrow wisely, understand interest, spot get-rich-quick scams and protect yourself with insurance.
outcomes: Tell needs from wants and set clear money goals
Make a monthly budget and track your spending
Build savings and an emergency fund, including through chamas and SACCOs
Use M-Pesa and other mobile money safely and avoid common frauds
Work out the true cost of a loan and the difference between simple and compound interest
Recognise pyramid and get-rich-quick schemes and understand insurance basics
